pattern: One native <input> with <label for>; visual cells are aria-hidden presentation. Chosen over N single-character inputs: one-time-code autofill and password managers fill one field, paste/undo/selection stay native, screen readers hear one labelled field with a length hint instead of N unlabelled boxes, and fast typing never loses characters to focus changes.

aria.value: Help text, the length hint ("6 digits"), then the visible error
"true" only while an error message is shown

keyboard.action: Enter a character; in a full code, typing overwrites the next character.
Native caret movement; the active cell follows.
Paste; a full code (spaces and dashes removed) replaces the value.

focus: The active cell shows the focus indicator (color-focus-ring border and 1px ring) while the input has focus.
notes: inputmode=numeric shows a numeric keypad for numeric codes.
WCAG 3.3.8: paste and autofill are supported, so users do not have to transcribe codes.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
